import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(99)
n = 1000
k = rng.integers(0, 2, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (2, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['label'] = [f'cls_{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: add a rectangle shape in map coordinates around several points
steps.eval: const { makeRect } = window.__shapesModule || (window.__shapesModule = {}); const wx = a.anchorXY[0]; const wy = a.anchorXY[1]; const r = { kind: 'rect', id: 'test-rect-1', x: wx - 20, y: wy - 20, w: 40, h: 40, rotation: 0, style: { strokeColor: [255, 0, 0, 220], fillColor: [255, 0, 0, 40], strokeWidth: 2, opacity: 1, dash: [], arrowHead: 'none' }, selected: false }; a.addShape(r);
steps.report: { nShapes: a.shapes.length, kind: a.shapes[0].kind, undoLabel: a.undoLabel }

steps.name: move the shape (undoable)
steps.eval: const s = a.shapes[0]; a.updateShape(s.id, { x: s.x + 5, y: s.y + 5 });

steps.name: add an ellipse
steps.eval: const wx = a.anchorXY[0]; const wy = a.anchorXY[1]; const e = { kind: 'ellipse', id: 'test-ell-1', cx: wx, cy: wy, rx: 30, ry: 20, rotation: 0, style: { strokeColor: [0, 100, 255, 220], fillColor: [0, 100, 255, 40], strokeWidth: 2, opacity: 1, dash: [], arrowHead: 'none' }, selected: false }; a.addShape(e);

steps.name: add a line shape
steps.eval: const wx = a.anchorXY[0]; const wy = a.anchorXY[1]; const l = { kind: 'line', id: 'test-line-1', points: [[wx - 10, wy], [wx + 10, wy + 5]], style: { strokeColor: [0, 200, 0, 220], fillColor: [0, 200, 0, 0], strokeWidth: 3, opacity: 1, dash: [], arrowHead: 'none' }, selected: false }; a.addShape(l);

steps.name: add a text shape
steps.eval: const wx = a.anchorXY[0]; const wy = a.anchorXY[1]; const t = { kind: 'text', id: 'test-text-1', x: wx, y: wy + 5, text: 'Atlas B4', fontSize: 14, fontFamily: 'sans-serif', style: { strokeColor: [255, 255, 255, 220], fillColor: [0, 0, 0, 0], strokeWidth: 1, opacity: 1, dash: [], arrowHead: 'none' }, selected: false }; a.addShape(t);

steps.name: shapes are still in place after view.reset
shapes are still in place after 2D rotation
tag points inside the rectangle
steps.eval: const rectShape = a.shapes.find(s => s.kind === 'rect'); if (rectShape) a.tagPointsInShape(rectShape.id, 'shape_tag');

steps.name: JSON export and re-import round-trip
steps.eval: const json = a.exportShapes(); a.shapes = []; const before = a.shapes.length; a.importShapes(json);
